title: Camp Nesher

services.name: Our Program
services.desc: over the course of the summer consists of three major areas: Daily Schedule, Special Programs, and Shabbat. Each Eidah (Division) follows a routine specifically designed for their age group beginning with morning tefillah and followed by an action-packed day including sports, waterfront, Torah-learning, and choice-based electives. Olympics, NFL Day, Water Carnival, and Color War are just a few of the highlights that add to the excitement of our Camp Nesher schedule. Shabbat is a warm and special time in Camp Nesher, and the part of our week that our whole camp family is together. From a Friday evening tefillah filled with singing and ruach all the way through to slow shirah

blurb: Camp Nesher is a Modern Orthodox Jewish summer camp for boys and girls entering 3rd through 10th grade, located in the beautiful northeast Pocono Mountains. Camp Nesher was built on a foundation that combines both bein adam l’chavero, treating others with respect, and hakarat hatov, acknowledging acts of kindness. These ideals remain at the very core of who we are and are imbued in everything we do.
